title: The night the sea came in

facts.text: The Reader passed Thimble's letter up from the sea.
facts.page: You passed Thimble's letter up from your own floor.

facts.text: The tide brought Thimble's letter up to the lighthouse.
facts.page: The tide brought Thimble's letter up to the lighthouse.

facts.text: Pip's light went up on a kite, high over the shore, and Pip stood in the dark.
facts.page: You gave Pip a kite, and his light went up high.

facts.text: Pip hung his light at the top of a ladder on the rocks, and stood in the dark.
facts.page: You gave Pip a ladder, and his light went up high.

facts.text: Moth carried Pip's light up high, and Pip stood in the dark.
facts.page: Moth carried Pip's light up high, and Pip stood in the dark.

facts.text: Thimble was pulled in off the rocks on her grandmother's thread.
facts.page: Thimble came in off the rocks on her grandmother's thread.

facts.text: Pip threw Thimble a line and hauled her in off the rocks.
facts.page: Thimble came in off the rocks on the line you gave.

facts.text: Thimble crossed from the rocks on a ladder laid like a bridge.
facts.page: Thimble crossed from the rocks on the ladder you gave.

facts.text: Thimble flew in off the rocks on a kite tail.
facts.page: Thimble flew in off the rocks on the kite you gave.

facts.text: The sea itself set Thimble down on the landing steps.
facts.page: The sea set Thimble down on the landing steps.

facts.text: Thimble came home to the Lost and Found by the light.
Pip wrote in the keeper's log for the first time.
